name: Weapon Diligence (Ex)
body:
Benefit: The magus can hone his familiarity with a specific weapon to direct his mental focus. The magus selects one weapon. When wielding that weapon, the magus gains a +3 bonus to all concentration checks. If the magus is 10th level or higher, the bonus increases to +6.
